title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Rental-Burden Months on a Revised Arrangement
content:
**Clause.** When an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement's installment is re-figured, rental-burden months are added to the remaining term according to the patient's ongoing monthly rentals, counting each of the wheelchair line (Mobility Equipment), the oxygen line (Home Oxygen Therapy) and the PAP device line (PAP Therapy Equipment) with a paid rental month whose service-from date falls fewer than 2 whole calendar months before the handling date.

| Ongoing rentals | Months added to the remaining term |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | 0 |

**Window (hypothetical).** Handling date 9 March: an oxygen equipment month with a service-from date of 1 February (1 whole month before) counts; one dated 1 January (2 whole months before) does not.

**Case (hypothetical).** Home Oxygen Therapy months paid for February, a wheelchair already owned, no PAP device: one rental, 1 month added.
